'''2005 Corellia Regional''' was a Star Wars CCG regional played on 9 January 2005 at PasTimes in Niles, Illinois, a qualifier for the [[2005 World Championship]] with two Day 2 byes and the Players Committee's Ultimate prize package.<ref name="pcf-4269">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050215052109/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=4269&amp Corellia Regional Jan. 9!!], Kevin Brownell and Brandon Schele (17 December 2004 – 10 January 2005), Player's Committee Forums, swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 15 February 2005.</ref> [[Brandon Schele]] won, beating [[Michael Raveling|Mike Raveling]] in the final confrontation. Schele, the reigning World Champion, already held a bye, so the byes went to Raveling and [[Frank Amador]], and Schele won the virtual card design.<ref name="pcf-4269" /><ref name="pc-events05">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050828001521/http://swccgpc.com:80/events.htm 2004/2005 Events: SWCCG 2005 Worlds Qualifiers Listing (updated 27 June 2005)], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 28 August 2005.</ref>

== Results ==

Final results as posted by Brandon Schele on the PC forums ("that I know of").<ref name="pcf-4269" />

|-
| 2nd || [[Michael Raveling|Mike Raveling]] || 5–1 || TRM / Walkers
|-
| 3rd || [[Frank Amador]] || 4–2 || MBO / SYCFA Fear (V)
|-
| 4th || [[Kevin Brownell]] || 4–2 || Careful Planning Tousche Station and Outskirts / SYCFA

In the final confrontation Schele played Dark first and won by 18; Raveling conceded the second game.<ref name="pcf-4269" />
